requirement_summary: Create an organization using an allowlisted display name; derive the initial owner membership from the authenticated actor
List only organizations in which caller has an active verified membership; switch active org through server-verified membership
Invite an email to a bounded allowed role and track pending/accepted/expired/revoked invitations
Revoke or change a member role and invalidate authorization immediately on subsequent requests
Enforce organization membership and record-policy checks for every entity read, write, relation lookup, aggregate and export
Deny blanket platform support access to customer records unless a separately reviewed just-in-time support flow exists
Expose purchased/enabled application grants and organization plan limits to an authorized role
Apply app entitlements, usage ceilings and relevant role checks on protected writes, batch operations and jobs
Record immutable-meaning audit of critical actions and denied privileged attempts, scoped by org and actor
Provide a hosted payment-provider checkout/portal handoff after provider/legal terms are approved
Handle later approved billing-provider callbacks via verified signatures and idempotent state mapping
Create and edit a lead with name, company context, contact channel, source, assigned owner and allowed status
List/search/filter leads within organization and assigned/team scope, with pagination and deterministic sort
Progress lead stage according to configured pipeline rules with tracked actor/time
Create/update an Account with required name and optional permitted business metadata
Create/update Contacts and associate them with same-organization Accounts, if permitted
Warn on potential duplicate Account/Contact candidates within a tenant rather than silently merging
Create a Deal linked to same-org Account/Contact, pipeline, stage, owner and optional Agent reference
Change deal stage only via authorized/valid transition and preserve activity history
Create, assign, reschedule and complete a task linked to authorized lead/account/deal
Filter deals/tasks by owner, stage, age and due status with team-scoped counts
Show individual workload without exposing a different team's restricted records
Accept only approved CSV column mappings and synthetically safe test datasets in sandbox
Export only permitted tenant/record fields after authorization with auditable request and expiring link if file delivery used
Provide consistent loading/empty/validation/error/forbidden/expired UI states across CRUD/list forms
Prevent accidental duplicate submissions and represent server outcomes consistently in desktop/mobile clients
Create merchant organization record plus optional location and link to same-org CRM lead/account/deal and assigned Agent
Associate merchant with an internal Agent and retain assignment history after reassignment
Open an internal merchant application, assign operations owner, stage and next permissible action
Create required next-action task and due date for a blocked/internal pending application
View stalled queue filtering status, age, assigned owner and next action
Show reason a case awaits further input and avoid claiming it is externally approved
Define organization-specific internal stages and valid transitions in configurable schema
Apply a validated stage transition with transactionally consistent history and future outbox event
Maintain bounded non-sensitive application checklist status and timestamped actor trail
Create/disable Agent and agent-to-merchant relationships with tenant boundaries
Ensure agent reassignment and membership revocation invalidate old portfolio access and are audited
Maintain a separate external processor status reference with source, observedAt and verification state
Reject unsigned, invalid, replayed or out-of-order external event updates in later connector
Provide tenant-scoped counts for awaiting info, internal review, pending external and activation follow-up
Present date-range, owner and stage filters with consistent empty and unavailable states
Load approved fictional tenant data for two organizations and at least five distinct merchant cases
Run negative scenarios for cross-tenant read, denied stage changes and prohibited fields once code exists
Direct processor onboarding connector deferred until contracts, API rights and security design are authorized
Residual statement import, commission calculation and payouts deferred pending real sample formats, reconciliation and approval
Agent self-service portal deferred until external identity and record-scope review
Hardware, serial numbers, technician dispatch and terminal provisioning deferred
Underwriting, full KYC/KYB and money movement deferred to separately scoped regulated systems
Future major Zoho-like app families each require their own PRD, permissions, entitlements and release acceptance
